properties.name: ai.circuit-breaker.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable AI circuit breaker protection.

properties.name: ai.circuit-breaker.failure-threshold
properties.description: Consecutive failures required before opening the breaker.

properties.name: ai.circuit-breaker.open-duration-seconds
properties.description: How long the breaker stays open before probing.

properties.name: ai.circuit-breaker.half-open-success-threshold
properties.description: Consecutive probe successes needed to close the breaker.
